tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List the ARC-AGI-3 games available to play (game_id, title, tags).

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start playing a game. Returns a session_id and the first full frame. A frame is a 64x64 grid, one hex digit per cell (the palette index 0-f), rows labelled by y, columns by x (origin top-left). Set online:true only when the user wants an arcprize.org scorecard: online play is slower and rate-limited.

game_id.description: A game_id from list_games (the base id before '-' also works).

online.description: Play against arcprize.org with a real scorecard instead of locally.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Take one action. ACTION6 needs x (column) and y (row), 0-63, origin top-left; other actions take no coordinates. frame defaults to 'diff': only changed rows. reasoning is shown live to the user and forwarded to the toolkit.

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Reset the game (the current level, or the whole game after a win). The only way to continue after GAME_OVER. frame defaults to 'full'. reasoning is shown live to the user.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Re-read a session's latest state and frame without acting. frame defaults to 'full'.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End a session and close its scorecard. Returns the final state and score summary. Always call this when done.

tools.name: script_access
tools.description: Get a fresh token for scripting this session (invalidates the previous one).

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List game sessions (newest first), e.g. to recover a session_id. scope 'mine' (default) is the ones you started.
